name: Special Meeting and Adjournment Memo
agenda_text:
The City of San Diego
Office of Council President Joe LaCava
First District
M e m o r a n d u m
date: June 1, 2026
to: Honorable City Councilmembers
from: Council President Joe LaCava, District 1
subject: Special City Council Meeting and Adjournment of Regular Meeting
_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________
The regularly scheduled City Council Meeting on Monday, June 8, 2026, has been adjourned. In its stead, the City Council will convene for a Special Meeting on Monday, June 8, 2026, during the following times.
The Council will convene at 10:00 a.m. in open session to hear the following items:
Proclamations: Cliff "Rip" Rippetoe Day
United States Police & Fire Championships Week
Eritrean Independence Day 2026
Consent Agenda Items: Approval of Council Minutes.
Ordinance Approving Contract with AskReply, Inc. dba B2Gnow for Contract and Labor Compliance Software (RFP 10090221-25-V).
Approve Project List to be Funded by the Fiscal Year 2027 Road Maintenance and Rehabilitation Account (RMRA) Funds.
Fourth Amendment to Vendor Agreement 4500023939 and First Amendment to Sole Source #4249 Between the City of San Diego and Riskonnect Inc.
Request for an Extension of the Obligations of Construction Contract #K-21-1966-DBB-3 with Burtech Pipeline, Inc. Beyond Five Years to June 14,2027, for the Construction of Sewer Group 843 Project.
Amendments to Chapter 6, Article 4, Divisions 1, 2, 3, and 5 of the Municipal Code all Related to the Industrial Wastewater Control Program.
Amendment to Chapter 6, Article 7, Division 38 of the San Diego Municipal Code.
Amendments to Live Entertainment Worker Safety Ordinance.
Authorization of a First Amendment to the Contract with Professional Account Management dba Duncan Solutions for Parking Citation Processing and Related Services.
Request Approval of a Second Amendment to the Consultant Agreement (H186974) with Kleinfelder Inc. for Time Extension of Professional Services During the Construction of Lakeside Valve Station Replacement Project.
2026 Update to the San Diego Municipal Code (Land Development Code) and Local Coastal Program, Minor Amendments to the Downtown Community Plan and General Plan, and Associated Implementing Actions.
Authorization to enter into a Contract with Focus Psychological Service, Inc., to provide Psychological Consulting Services for the San Diego Police Department.
Authorization to Execute a Contract with NRC Environmental Services, Inc. (ITB 10090459-26-S) to Provide as needed Jetting and Pipe Cleaning at Public Utilities Wastewater Treatment Facilities.
Authorize the retention of the law firm Stoel Rives, LLP for legal services related to a Notice of Violation and Intent to File Suit letter from California River Watch.
Authorization to Grant an Easement to San Diego Gas & Electric on City-Owned Property for Circuit 157 (Sections D, E & F) along Lyons Valley Road, Barrett Lake Road, and Skye Valley Road (APNs 599-160-02 et al.).
First Amendment to Agreement for Legal Services with Collins + Collins LLP to Provide Continuing Legal Services as Outside Counsel.
Exclusive Negotiation Agreement (7th and Market Street) between the City of San Diego and The Robert Green Company.
Establishment of Overtime Eligibility of Classifications in the Classified Service for Fiscal Year 2027.
Settlement of Brietta Cooper v. City of San Diego, San Diego Superior Court No. 37-2023-00034308-CU-PA-CTL, Claim No. 33851.
Settlement of Carmel Mountain Ranch v. City of San Diego, San Diego Superior Court Case No. 25CU005692C, Claim No. 37297.
Settlement of Tatyana Badalov v. City of San Diego, San Diego Superior Court No. 25CU000156C, Claim No. 36402.
Appointment to the Balboa Park Committee.
Appointment to the Resiliency Advisory Board.
Reappointments to the Mobility Board.
Appointment to the Accessibility Advisory Board.
Discussion Agenda Items: Prohousing Designation Program Application.
Non-agenda Public Comment
The Council will then recess and reconvene at 2:00 p.m. to hear the following:
Discussion Agenda Items: Presentation on the Status of Vacancies, Recruitment and Retention Efforts Per Government Code Section 3502.3.
Authorization of the First Amendment to Contract H2426362-M with Brown and Caldwell for design and construction services for the PS 2 Improvements and Modernization Project.
Authorization for City of San Diego Fiscal Year 2027 Tax and Revenue Anticipation Notes.
Construction Change Order #5 with PCL Construction Services, Inc for the installation of a new batting cage for Mira Mesa Community Park Improvements Phase II.
If you have questions, please contact Luz Anaya Luna, Director of Legislative Affairs, at (619) 235-5880 or lanayaluna@sandiego.gov and Heidi Palmer, Legislative Analyst, at (619) 533-3920 or palmerh@sandiego.gov .
cc: Honorable Mayor Todd Gloria
Honorable City Attorney Heather Ferbert
Charles Modica, Independent Budget Analyst
Diana Fuentes, City Clerk
